glossEn: assets available for use in the production of further assets / wealth in the form of money or property owned by a person or business and human resources of economic value
note: 英文两条 synset 合并：assets available for use in production + wealth in the form of money or property。这是同义归一 —— WordNet 把「资本」拆成资产/财富两个 synset，学习者不可能判别。
a seat of government。政府的所在地。**英文独有，现有库没有这个名词义** —— 中文侧只收了 首都的（形容词），漏了 首都。按英文切把它补回来。

glossEn: one of the large alphabetic characters used as the first letter in writing or printing proper names and sometimes for emphasis; capitals were kept in the upper half of the type case and so became known as upper-case letters
note: one of the large alphabetic characters used as the first letter… 因字型盒上半格得名 upper-case。

glossEn: a center that is associated more than any other with some activity or product / the upper part of a column that supports the entablature
note: [WORDNET 补缺 ECDICT 未收录] 英文 definition 无形容词义位，首都的/重要的 零覆盖，走补洞。另并入三条 WordNet 补缺义位（见 _mergeNote）：wn[4] a center associated with an activity 中心城、wn[5] the upper part of a column 柱顶盘、wn[6] first-rate 一流的。
